events.description: After donating an artifact, Gunther asks the farmer to donate any others they find.
Abigail's 2 heart event: she asks the farmer to play Journey of the Prairie King with her.
Abigail's 4 heart event: she plays her flute in the rain.
Abigail's 8 heart event: she brings out a spirit board, which starts to spell something.
Abigail's 6 heart event: she argues with Pierre about wanting to be an adventurer.
Follow-up to Abigail's 8 heart event: she apologises for what happened during her 8 heart event.
Maru's 2 heart event: she helps Demetrius with testing some samples.
Maru's 4 heart event: she accidentally breaks a medical sample.
Maru's 6 heart event: she goes stargazing with her telescope.
Maru's 8 heart event: she demonstrates her latest project and accidentally zaps the farmer.
Maru's 10 heart event: she finishes her work on MarILDA, who leaves for space.
Haley's 2 heart event: she and Emily argue over cleaning under the couch cushions.
Haley's 4 heart event: she has trouble opening a jar of pickles.
Haley's 6 heart event: the farmerhelps her find a lost bracelet.
Haley's 8 heart event: she visits Marnie's ranch and takes photos of the cows.
Haley's 10 heart event: she invites the farmer to see her dark room.
Pierre's 6 heart event: the farmer discovers Pierre's secret stash.
Caroline's 6 heart event: she argues with Abigail about expectations.
George's 6 heart event: he tells the farmer about his accident in the mines.
Evelyn's 4 heart event: she bakes cookies for the farmer.
Alex's 2 heart event: he throws a gridball around with the farmer.
Alex's 5 heart event: he discusses books and his worries.
Demetrius's 6 heart event: he brings back tomatoes as fruit from the store.
Linus's 4 heart event: he teaches the farmer to make wild bait.
Sebastian's 6 heart event: he and Sam invite the farmer to play Solarion Chronicles with them.
Sebastian's 8 heart event: he invites the farmer to stand under his umbrella on the dock.
Robin's 6 heart event: she teaches the farmer how to make a flute block and drum block.
Penny's 2 heart event: she tries to help George reach the mail by getting it for him.
Penny's 4 heart event: she and the farmer clean the trailer and Pam argues with her about it.
Penny's 6 heart event: she tries cooking for the farmer.
Penny's 10 heart event: she asks the farmer to come swimming with her in the spa pool at night.
Elliott's 2 heart event: he talks about wanting to become an author and ask the farmer what books they like.
Elliott's 4 heart event: he buys the farmer a drink and proposes a toast.
Elliott's 10 heart event: after finishing his book, he invites the farmer to come rowing with him.
Sam's 2 heart event: he plays music with the band and asks the farmer what sort of music they like.
Sam's 6 heart event: he skateboards outside Emily and Haley's house and argues with Lewis about it.
Sam's 4 heart event: he drops an egg in the process of making a snack.
Set-up for Sam's 8 heart event: he tells the farmer about the gig and when & where to meet.
Leah's 2 heart event: she shows the farmer her sculptures.
Leah's 4 heart event: she tells the farmer about Kel and asks whether she should have an art show or an internet shop.
Leah's 6 heart event: the farmer catches her falling from a tree.
Leah's 8 heart event (art show): she hosts her art show in the town square.
Leah's 10 heart event: she and the farmer have a picnic which is interrupted by Kel.
Set-up for Leah's 8 heart event (art show): she tells the farmer about the art show and when & where to meet.
Harvey's 2 heart event: he advises George on his health.
Harvey's 4 heart event: he gives the farmer a medical examination and takes their pulse.
Harvey's 6 heart event: he joins the aerobics club for exercise.
Kent returns to the valley and introduces himself to the farmer.
Demetrius asks the farmer whether they'd like a mushroom cave or a fruit bat cave.
Sandy welcomes the farmer and celebrates the bus line running again.
Marnie asks the farmer to bring a cave carrot for her goats.
Completion of Marnie's cave carrot quest.
Jodi asks the farmer to bring a largemouth bass for dinner.
Completion of Jodi's largemouth bass quest.
Completion of Jodi's largemouth bass quest. Variation if Kent has returned.
Gus's 4 heart event: he asks for help with getting Pam to pay her tab.
Clint's 3 heart event: he asks the farmer for advice about talking to Emily.
Kent's 3 heart event: he has a flashback to Gotoro when Jodi makes popcorn.
Clint's 6 heart event: he asks Emily out on a date.
Pierre tells the farmer he'll be selling new seeds in Year 2.
The Wizard teaches the farmer about junimos and gives them the forest potion.
Part of the introduction event. After the farmer arrives in Pelican Town, Robin and Lewis show them to their new farmhouse.
Marlon introduces himself and gives the farmer a sword.
Completion of Emily's gemstone quest.
Penny's 8 heart event: she asks the farmer to be a guest speaker for the children's field trip.
Pierre rallies the town to drive out Morris and JojaMart.
The bachelorettes confront the farmer about dating all of the girls.
The bachelors confront the farmer about dating all of the boys.
With a rabbit's foot in hand, the bachelorettes gossip about Lewis and Marnie.
With a rabbit's foot in hand, the bachelors have a pool tournament.
Sam's 10 heart event: he and the farmer sneak into his room.
Alex's 8 heart event: the farmer finds him with a music box and he tells them about his mother.
Jas and Vincent explore the sewer entrance.
Linus's 8 heart event: Robin offers to build him a house and he explains his philosophy on life.
Sebastian's 10 heart event: he takes the farmer on his motorbike to see Zuzu City in the distance.
Sebastian's 4 heart event: he works on his motorbike in the garage.
Willy gives the farmer the copper pan.
Completion of the Wizard's magic ink quest.
Elliott's 6 heart event: he plays the piano for the farmer.
Emily's 4 heart event: she finds an injured parrot and decides to care for it.
Emily's 2 heart event: she has a dream vision about the farmer.
Morris gives a speech about how Joja has revitalised the town.
Linus's 1 heart event: he goes looking for food in George's trash can and asks the farmer if it's wrong.
Pam's 9 heart event: she shows the farmer her Sign of the Vessel statue and talks about happiness.
Harvey's 10 heart event: he faces his fear and takes the farmer on a hot air balloon.
The Wizard tells the farmer about his ex-wife and asks them to get magic ink for him.
Grandpa returns and evaluates the farmer's progress.
After the farmer summons him, Grandpa returns and re-evaluates the farmer's progress.
Harvey's 8 heart event: he contacts a pilot on his radio.
Leah's 8 heart event (internet shop): the internet shop is a big success thanks to 'Mr K'.
Completion of Pam and Penny's house upgrade.
Shane's 2 heart event: he offers the farmer a drink while sitting on the lake dock.
Lewis and Marnie's 6 heart event: the farmer finds out about their secret relationship.
Marlon gives the farmer a slime egg and tells them about slime breeding.
Dwarf's 1 heart event: they and Krobus fight over their history with the Elemental Wars until the Wizard interrupts.
Willy's 6 heart event: his shop is overrun by crabs and Gus purchases them.
Caroline's 2 heart event: she relaxes and makes a cup of tea for the farmer.
Sam's 3 heart event: in Year 1, he and Vincent discuss Kent's return and the situation in Gotoro.
Willy's introduction event where he gives the farmer a fishing rod.
Shane's 7 heart event: with Emily and Clint's help, he films an ad for Joja Bluu.
Marnie asks the farmer if they'd like to adopt a dog.
Evelyn gives the farmer a garden pot and the crafting recipe for it.
Abigail's 10 heart event: she tries to explore the mines, but gets scared.
Alex's 10 heart event: he takes the farmer on a dinner date.
Emily's 6 heart event: she shows the farmer her dancing.
Completion of Pierre's gold-quality vegetables quest.
Gus's 5 heart event: he gives the farmer a Mini-Jukebox and the crafting recipe for it.
Leah's 6 heart event: she gives the farmer a sculpture she made for them.
Clint gives the farmer blueprints for a furnace.
Emily gives the farmer access to her sewing machine for tailoring. A variation with the same ID plays when the farmer is married to Emily.
Leo's introduction event.
Completion of Robin's hardwood quest.
Marnie asks the farmer if they'd like to adopt a cat.
Elliott's 8 heart event: he performs a reading of his new novel.
Follow-up to Shane's 6 heart event: he apologises for what happened and tells the farmer he's started therapy.
Alex's 6 heart event: he reflects and apologises to the farmer.
The bear teaches the farmer special knowledge about the forest.
Emily's 8 heart event: she runs a Clothing Therapy session.
Emily's 10 heart event: she and the farmer go camping and are surprised by a bear.
Set-up for Shane's 10 heart event: he tells the farmer about the gridball game and when & where to meet.
The candles on Grandpa's shrine light up.
Alex's 4 heart event: he tells the farmer about his father and shows them his dog Dusty.
Sebastian's 2 heart event: Robin interrupts him while he's programming.
Leah's 14 heart event: she and the farmer paint Marnie's portrait.
Morris offers 50% off coupons to steal Pierre's customers.
Completion of Willy's bug meat quest.
Completion of Gus's egg quest.
Shane's 8 heart event: he shows the farmer his blue chickens.
Shane's 4 heart event: he's passed out in his room and is found by Marnie and the farmer.
Shane's 7 heart event: he's cut back on beer and buys Jas the bunny-jewel slippers.
Shane's 6 heart event: he has a breakdown on the cliff's edge.
Jas and Vincent pick spring onions.
Set-up for Leah's 14 heart event: she tells the farmer about the painting session and when & where to meet.
Elliott's 14 heart event: he tells the farmer about his upcoming book tour.
Follow-up to Elliott's 14 heart event: he returns back home.
Shane's 14 heart event (part 1): he comes out of the saloon and Marnie and Jas are suspicious of his behaviour.
Shane's 14 heart event (part 2): he comes out of the saloon again and the farmer asks him if he's been drinking.
Shane's 14 heart event (part 3): he reveals that he's been playing at the arcade frequently and drinking Joja Cola.
Set-up for Alex's 14 heart event (part 1): he asks the farmer for 5,000g for a secret project.
Set-up for Alex's 14 heart event (part 2): the farmer is reminded to visit the saloon.
Alex's 14 heart event: he sets up the saloon's backroom as a TV den for watching gridball
Set-up for Emily's 14 heart event: she asks the farmer to bring her 200 pieces of fiber for a secret project.
Emily's 14 heart event: she gives the farmer a custom set of clothing that she's made for them.
Harvey's 14 heart event: he prepares a home-cooked dinner for the farmer.
Set-up for Maru's 14 heart event: she tells the farmer about the comet and when & where to meet.
Sam's 14 heart event (part 1): he tells the farmer he's going to look for a job with music.
Sam's 14 heart event (part 2): he receives a job offer for a children's TV show composer.
Sam's 14 heart event (part 3): he comes around to the idea of doing kids' music.
Sam's 14 heart event (part 4): he, Jas, and Vincent watch the show with his music.
Sam's 8 heart event: he, Abigail, Sebastian, and the farmer head into Zuzu City to play a gig.
Penny's 14 heart event: she remodels the farmhouse's bedroom.
Set-up for Penny's 14 heart event: she tells the farmer about her plans to remodel the bedroom and asks what style they like.
Maru's 14 heart event: she watches the comet with the farmer.
Completion of Evelyn's leek quest.
Set-up for Haley's 14 heart event (part 1): she overhears Jas, Vincent, and Penny talking about how their old schoolbooks are falling apart.
Haley's 14 heart event: she successfully hosts a cakewalk to raise money for Penny and the children.
Leo's 4 heart event: he contemplates what 'normal' is.
Leo's 2 heart event: he discusses his life in comparison with the farmer's.
Leo's 6 heart event: Linus invites him to come live in Pelican Town with him.
Abigail's 14 heart event: she saves the farmer from a wilderness golem.
Krobus's 14 heart event: he goes for a ride with a sea monster.
Completion of Linus's trash quest.
Set-up for Haley's 14 heart event (part 2): she tells the farmer about the cakewalk, when & where to meet, and to bring a cake.
Leo's 9 heart event: a montage of him settling into life in the Valley.
Sebastian's 14 heart event (part 1): he catches an injured frog with the farmer's help.
Sebastian's 14 heart event (part 2): he shows the farmer the frog terrarium he set up.
Willy shows the farmer his broken boat and asks if they'd like to help repair it.
Shane's 10 heart event: he invites the farmer to come watch a gridball game with him.
Qi congratulates the farmer on finding all the golden walnuts and discovering the hidden room.
Lewis and Robin reveal the special orders board.
